title: Proton Pets 2026 Unites Ghostbusters Fan Groups in Support of Animal Welfare
excerpt: Spearheaded by Ghostbusters Virginia, the pet food donation and outreach campaign brought together Ghostbusters groups, rallying behind a shared mission to support local animal shelters, pet pantries, and rescue organizations. Leading the charge, the Virginia crew alone raised over $2,000 for their SPCA partners, underscoring what quickly became a much greater, coordinated effort.
